title: The Harbor Tote
_comment_colorways: ONLY colorways we are actually manufacturing. hex guides the recolour prompt. Per-colorway price and sku are optional overrides.

_comment_description: description_html is the buy-box description. A pre-order notice goes at the TOP of it, scoped to the colorway, with a supplier-confirmed ship month.
